title: Pensacola Case Resolution (Eglin)
doc_notes: This is an AARO case resolution report regarding a military pilot's encounter with an object, which the agency concludes was a lighter-than-air balloon.

encounters.summary: A military pilot reported a rounded, cone-shaped object while operating in a training range, describing it as having a paneled surface, orange-red coloring, and a potential engine, while experiencing a radar malfunction during the approach.
encounters.location_name: Eglin Air Force Base training range, Florida
encounters.quote: The pilot visually perceived a heat signature emanating from the rounded bottom portion, which they described as blurry air.
